vb_textbox.text: If the one that has cut appears on left first, ignore it as it probably has 0 value. If the cut one is on right hand side, take it for 2/3 times then select the opposite one. Ignore the purple long mushroom on either sides until the other mushroom shows value 1. Once the other mushroom shows value 1, select purple one until it shows value 0/1 and repeat.
